name: Iran nuclear programme
value: No IAEA access; talks stalled 8 Nov
summary: Iran says mediators stopped travelling after the US midterms; Trump ties any renewed strikes to the talks
state: Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi said on state TV on 8 Nov that mediators had stopped travelling after the shock of the US election results (Israel Hayom; Khaleej Times). President Trump told CNN the same day that renewed strikes were unlikely to be needed while nuclear and Hormuz talks progress. AP reported on 8 Nov that Iran is reviewing Qatari proposals but will not negotiate on nuclear issues until the US meets its conditions (ABC Australia). No strike on a nuclear site was reported as of 8 Nov.
for_you: No public safety guidance applies. The dispute feeds into the risk of renewed Gulf hostilities and into energy prices.
